title: ManhattanGrid test suite
description:
Comprehensive tests for ManhattanGrid mobility pattern:
- Test grid snapping produces valid grid coordinates
- Test movement stays on grid lines
- Test intersection detection accuracy
- Test direction changes only occur at intersections
- Test pause probability respects configured value (statistical test)
- Test boundary handling
- Test deterministic behavior with seeded RNG

Follow existing test patterns in python/tests/.
